stock.description: Shanghai Gench Education Group Limited functions as an investment holding entity primarily focused on providing tertiary education services throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's main activity involves the management of a private university situated in Shanghai, which delivers a variety of academic offerings, including undergraduate programs. As reported on December 31, 2021, this university offered a comprehensive selection of 71 distinct majors and specializations within its undergraduate curriculum, in addition to 12 fields of study for its junior college programs. The company was established in 1999 and its corporate headquarters are located in Shanghai, China.
